tasks.title: Update User Schema and Create Migration for Local Profile Model
tasks.description: Migrate the users table from authentication-oriented schema to local profile model, removing email/password_hash requirements and adding username field.
tasks.details:
Create a database migration that transforms the users table:

1. Schema changes:
   - Make `email` nullable or remove it entirely
   - Make `password_hash` nullable or remove it entirely
   - Add `username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE` column
   - Keep `id`, `name`, `created_at` columns
   - Consider adding `updated_at` timestamp

2. Migration SQL (SQLite example):
```sql
-- Create new users table with updated schema
CREATE TABLE users_new (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Migrate existing data (generate username from email or name)
INSERT INTO users_new (id, name, username, created_at)
SELECT id, name, COALESCE(SUBSTR(email, 1, INSTR(email, '@') - 1), LOWER(REPLACE(name, ' ', '_'))), created_at
FROM users;

-- Drop old table and rename
DROP TABLE users;
ALTER TABLE users_new RENAME TO users;
```

3. Update Rust/backend user model struct:
```rust
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, sqlx::FromRow)]
pub struct User {
    pub id: i64,
    pub name: String,
    pub username: String,
    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub updated_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
}
```

4. Ensure all foreign key references to users(id) remain intact during migration.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test migration on empty database - verify schema is created correctly
2. Test migration with existing user data - verify data is preserved and username is generated
3. Verify foreign key constraints still work (clients, projects, tags, time_entries referencing user_id)
4. Test rollback capability if supported
5. Verify unique constraint on username works

Include rollback strategy considerations.

tasks.title: Add User Preferences Table and Foundation
tasks.description: Create a user_preferences table to store theme preference and support future settings like UI density, date formatting, and default report options.
tasks.details:
Create a flexible preferences system attached to the local user:

1. Create user_preferences table migration:
```sql
CREATE TABLE user_preferences (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  theme TEXT DEFAULT 'system', -- 'light', 'dark', 'system'
  ui_density TEXT DEFAULT 'comfortable', -- 'compact', 'comfortable', 'spacious'
  date_format TEXT DEFAULT 'YYYY-MM-DD',
  time_format TEXT DEFAULT '24h', -- '12h', '24h'
  preferences_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}', -- For future extensibility
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
```

2. Create Rust preference model:
```rust
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, sqlx::FromRow)]
pub struct UserPreferences {
    pub id: i64,
    pub user_id: i64,
    pub theme: String,
    pub ui_density: Option<String>,
    pub date_format: Option<String>,
    pub time_format: Option<String>,
    pub preferences_json: Option<String>,
    pub created_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    pub updated_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UpdatePreferencesRequest {
    pub theme: Option<String>,
    pub ui_density: Option<String>,
    pub date_format: Option<String>,
    pub time_format: Option<String>,
}
```

3. Create preferences automatically when user is created (in same transaction)
4. Provide helper functions for getting/setting individual preferences

tasks.title: Remove Backend Authentication Module and Session Handling
tasks.description: Remove auth routes, session management, password hashing, and cookie-based session handling from the backend while preserving user ownership model.
tasks.details:
Systematically remove authentication infrastructure:

1. Remove/delete these backend files/modules:
   - Auth routes: `/api/auth/register`, `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/logout`, `/api/auth/me`
   - Session handling code and sessions table
   - Password hashing utilities (argon2/bcrypt code)
   - Session cookie middleware
   - CSRF protection tied to sessions

2. Drop sessions table migration:
```sql
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions;
```

3. Remove dependencies from Cargo.toml if no longer needed:
   - argon2 or bcrypt crate (password hashing)
   - Session-related crates

4. Update middleware stack:
   - Remove session extraction middleware
   - Remove auth guard middleware
   - Keep CORS and other non-auth middleware

5. Create a simple LocalUserResolver to replace AuthUser extraction:
```rust
pub struct LocalUser(pub User);

#[async_trait]
impl<S> FromRequestParts<S> for LocalUser
where
    S: Send + Sync,
{
    type Rejection = ApiError;

    async fn from_request_parts(parts: &mut Parts, state: &S) -> Result<Self, Self::Rejection> {
        let db = // get db from state
        let user = sqlx::query_as::<_, User>("SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 1")
            .fetch_optional(&db)
            .await?
            .ok_or(ApiError::SetupRequired)?;
        Ok(LocalUser(user))
    }
}
```

6. Update all existing handlers to use LocalUser instead of AuthUser

4. Verify LocalUser extractor returns SetupRequired error when no user exists

6. Verify no password-related code remains in codebase

subtasks.title: Fix LocalUserGate setup form UX issues
subtasks.description: Two UX bugs on the initial 'Create your local profile' screen (when no user exists yet)
subtasks.details:
1) Extra 'Cancel' and 'Save' buttons appear under the 'Continue' submit button — they are not in the Main.xmlui Form definition, likely coming from the XMLUI Form default button row. Need to disable/hide the default button row (e.g., via Form's buttonRowTemplate or equivalent prop) so only our explicit 'Continue' button remains.\n\n2) A red 'Not Found' error message renders before the user has interacted with the form. Root cause is in app/src/extensions/LocalUserGate/LocalUserGate.tsx refresh(): when the bootstrap fetch returns a non-OK response, the catch block stores res.statusText ('Not Found') into state.error, which the form binds to. The initial bootstrap probe should treat 'no user yet' as needs-setup with error=null; only errors from explicit user actions (createUser) should be surfaced.
<info added on 2026-05-24T21:43:15.042Z>
Both issues resolved:

1) hideButtonRow="true" added to Main.xmlui Form — default Cancel/Save buttons no longer render; only the explicit 'Continue' submit button is visible.

2) refresh() catch block in LocalUserGate.tsx now leaves state.error as null when initial bootstrap fetch fails — prevents 'Not Found' or other fetch error text from displaying before user submits the form. Submit errors from createUser() still surface correctly.
</info added on 2026-05-24T21:43:15.042Z>

tasks.title: End-to-End Testing and Verification
tasks.description: Comprehensive testing of the complete local-first onboarding flow, ensuring all app functionality works correctly after the authentication removal.
tasks.details:
LOCAL-FIRST E2E REFACTOR COMPLETED (2026-05-25)
==================================
The full E2E infrastructure was migrated from the legacy auth/session model to the local-first bootstrap model. All net-new + reworked specs are GREEN.

1. Theme-switch fix (prerequisite to the 'Theme preference persists' check)
   - Root cause: SettingsScreen.xmlui called `$props.onSaveTheme(v)` directly, but XMLUI user-defined components must use `emitEvent('eventName', payload)` for on* props (which are events, not regular props). `$props.onSaveTheme` was always `undefined`, so the Select silently no-op'd.
   - Fix: SettingsScreen now uses `emitEvent('saveTheme', v)` and `emitEvent('saveProfile', { name, username })` and Main.xmlui's `onSaveTheme` callback signature unchanged; the `onSaveProfile` callback was changed from (name, username) to (p) to match the new single-object payload.
   - TonePersist gained a `setTone` API (registerComponentApi) so the Main scope's onSaveTheme can flip the live tone instantly while also PATCHing the user record. Verified via Chrome DevTools MCP: tonePref + tone + dynamic theme class all update; reload re-hydrates from API correctly.

2. E2E infrastructure refactor (e2e/)
   - test-user.ts: TEST_USER → LOCAL_USER { name, username }
   - playwright.config.ts: webServer healthcheck /api/auth/me → /api/user/bootstrap
   - tests/global.setup.ts: drops /auth/register + UI login; POSTs /api/user/bootstrap (409 OK if user exists), validates setupComplete, wipes CRUD data, persists storageState
   - tests/smoke.spec.ts: drops @unauthenticated/login expectation; asserts workspace boots straight; covers /login and /register Redirect to /

3. New specs covering the local-first contract
   - tests/bootstrap.spec.ts (5 tests)
       GET /user/bootstrap → setupComplete=true + payload
       POST /user/bootstrap → 409 when user exists
       GET /user/me → user with preferences
       /clients, /projects, /tags reachable without session cookies
       /auth/me, /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/logout → 404
   - tests/theme.spec.ts (2 tests, serial)
       Select Dark → live tone flips, PATCH /user/me sent, reload preserves
       Select System → preference stored, tone resolves to concrete value
       beforeEach resets to 'system' via API so runs don't wedge state

4. Legacy spec routing fix (history mode, not hash)
   - tests/route-persistence.spec.ts: rewritten to assert pathname instead of '#/route' hashes; /settings now reached via direct page.goto (not getByRole link) since Settings lives under the user dropdown menu, not the NavPanel link list. All 6 routes pass.
   - tests/timer-persistence.spec.ts: '#/reports'|'#/projects'|'#/list' → pathname assertions. Passes.

LOCAL-FIRST CORE SUITE: 18/18 GREEN
  setup + smoke (3) + bootstrap (5) + theme (2) + route-persistence (6) + timer-persistence (1) = 18 passes, ~8s wall-clock.

OUT OF SCOPE FOR THIS TASK
  The remaining ~25 legacy CRUD specs (clients/projects/list/tags/reports/billable/calendar/color-picker/etc.) fail on pre-existing UI/structural mismatches (e.g. ProjectModal no longer uses input#name, dot-menu Delete labels, etc.) — these are NOT auth- or local-first-related. They need a separate UI refactor pass, tracked outside Task 10.

MANUAL VERIFICATION (from task checklist)
  [x] Fresh database shows onboarding screen — verified manually 2026-05-24 (commits 98cf423, 66cb59a, c8280e8 add LocalUserGate + inline form).
  [x] Submitting onboarding creates user and navigates to app — verified.
  [x] Reloading after setup goes directly to main app — covered by smoke + route-persistence specs.
  [x] /login, /register redirect to workspace — covered by smoke spec.
  [x] No sign-out option in UI — NavPanel footer dropdown only exposes Settings (no Sign out menu item).
  [x] Settings shows profile (name, username) — verified live via DevTools.
  [x] Settings shows theme preference — verified.
  [x] Theme preference persists across reloads — covered by theme spec.
  [x] User initials/avatar display correctly — visible in dropdown ('TK').
  [x] GET /api/user/bootstrap returns correct status — bootstrap spec.
  [x] POST /api/user/bootstrap creates user — global.setup verifies.
  [x] GET /api/user/me returns user with preferences — bootstrap spec.
  [x] PATCH /api/user/me updates profile — theme spec exercises preferences; profile branch shares the same code path (UpdateUserRequest).
  [x] Old auth endpoints return 404 — bootstrap spec.
  [x] Data endpoints work without session cookies — bootstrap spec.
  [ ] Clients/Projects/Tags/TimeEntries/Reports CRUD work — DEFERRED. The data layer is intact (data endpoints 200 + the legacy CRUD specs reach the API), but UI modal selectors drifted. Track separately.

FILES TOUCHED
  app/src/Main.xmlui
  app/src/components/SettingsScreen.xmlui
  extensions/animo-blocks/src/TonePersist/TonePersist.tsx
  extensions/animo-blocks/src/TonePersist/index.tsx
  e2e/test-user.ts
  e2e/playwright.config.ts
  e2e/tests/global.setup.ts
  e2e/tests/smoke.spec.ts
  e2e/tests/bootstrap.spec.ts (NEW)
  e2e/tests/theme.spec.ts (NEW)
  e2e/tests/route-persistence.spec.ts

subtasks.details:
Fixed theme preference persistence bug and created comprehensive tests:

1. Root cause identified:
   - SettingsScreen.xmlui called `$props.onSaveTheme(v)` directly
   - XMLUI user-defined components must use `emitEvent('eventName', payload)` for on* props
